data.name: LyricsStudioSettings.Description
data.value: Listens to a song and times its lyrics word by word — or writes them down when there are none. Everything runs on this computer; you review each song before anything is saved.

data.value: Save enhanced LRC with a time for every word (karaoke sweep). Off saves one time per line.

data.name: LyricsStudioSettings.EmbedTags
data.value: Also write lyrics into the file's tags

data.name: LyricsStudioSettings.EmbedTagsHint
data.value: The .lrc file next to the song is always written; this additionally stores the plain lyrics inside the audio file.

data.name: LyricsStudioSettings.OpenHelp
data.value: Opens Lyrics Studio with up to 40 songs that lack the format above: with word-by-word timings on, songs with only line-timed LRC are included; songs that already have ELRC are not. You can also right-click any songs → Lyrics → Open in Lyrics Studio.

data.name: LyricsStudio.Subtitle
data.value: Times your lyrics against the recording, or transcribes when there are none. Review each song, fix any word, then save.

data.name: LyricsStudio.SkipAlreadyTimed
data.value: Skip songs that already have this format

data.name: LyricsStudio.SkipAlreadyTimedTip
data.value: ELRC (a time for every word) and LRC (one time per line) are different formats. With word timings on, songs that only have line-timed LRC are still processed; songs that already have ELRC are left alone.

data.name: LyricsStudio.NeedsFfmpeg
data.value: ffmpeg is needed to decode songs. Set its path under Settings → Audio → Audio tools, then reopen Lyrics Studio.

data.value: Pick a song. Songs that already have synced lyrics open here right away; press Start for the rest. Check the words, nudge the timing and save.

data.value: Ignore the found lyrics and write down what is actually sung
